requests.name: off_route_calibration
requests.what: V_local at the blind run's own highest-scoring molecules on this task -- far from the teacher anchor, already scored, and the only way to learn whether high future value exists off-route here.

requests.name: arm_candidates
requests.recommendation: DO NOT SPEND YET. On this task the available candidates sit at similarity ~0.21 with nothing but novelty to recommend them, and the priority-1 calibration is what makes their number interpretable. Spend when an arm produces a candidate with a reason, or after the calibration lands.

payload.why_a_proxy_is_not_enough: Every offline proxy that validates against Test B is teacher-referenced or a route-position artifact, so it scores a high-value molecule in an unrelated basin as zero. That is the case the superseding definition exists to credit.
